report.markdown:
# Population Comparison

## Comparison

Nigeria has the larger population compared to Brazil. [1][2][3] One source reports that the current population of Nigeria is estimated at 242,431,832 people at mid-year in 2026. [3] In contrast, the current estimated population of Brazil is approximately 213.8 million people in 2026. [1][2]

## Sources

1. [Brazil Population 2026](https://worldpopulationreview.com/countries/brazil) — worldpopulationreview.com, published 2026-10-28, fetched 2026-10-31
2. [Brazil Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/brazil-population) — worldometers.info, fetched 2026-10-31
3. [Nigeria Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/nigeria-population) — worldometers.info, fetched 2026-10-31
